content.short: KuCoin provides a centralized cryptocurrency exchange serving international markets.
content.description: KuCoin is a major cryptocurrency exchange that enables users to buy, sell, and trade digital assets. It provides core trading options, as well as margin and futures trading, along with peer-to-peer (P2P) trading and a variety of other products and tools. For developers, the platform offers an API to retrieve data endpoints for their applications and access to the sandbox, supporting integration with dapps and testing in a contained environment.
content.meta: KuCoin is a cryptocurrency exchange offering buying, selling, and trading cryptocurrencies. Discover KuCoin and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
